# pvecli ct image

Manage LXC image files.

## add

Download an LXC image from the Proxmox repository.

```text
pvecli ct image add [NODE] [STORAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-na`, `--name VALUE` | Template filename to download. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## remove

Remove an LXC image from storage.

```text
pvecli ct image remove [NODE] [STORAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-na`, `--name VALUE` | Template filename to remove. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## list

List all LXC images in a storage.

```text
pvecli ct image list [NODE] [STORAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage name. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
